samples.summary: Cut-paste source clearing still bypasses the `consumeSpillBlocker()` contract the diff establishes for drag-move
samples.evidence: The diff adds `consumeSpillBlocker()` to both `moveRangeTo` clearing loops (sheet.ts:2392, 2461) and re-queues the unblocked anchors so a blocked spill recovers. The sibling path `paste()` clears the cut source range at packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:2227-2236 (`await this.store.delete({ r, c })`) with no `consumeSpillBlocker()` call and no unblocked-anchor injection into the `dependantsMap` built at line 2219 — and that recalculation happens BEFORE the source clearing anyway. So cutting a cell that was blocking a spill leaves the anchor stuck at `#REF!` exactly like the bug the diff fixes for drag-move. The registration also stays in `spillBlockers`, keyed to a now-empty cell.

samples.summary: `mergeSelection` clears covered cells without consuming their spill blockers
samples.evidence: packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:4384-4396 deletes/blanks every non-anchor cell in the merge range, then recalculates from `expanded` (line 4402-4404), but never calls `consumeSpillBlocker(sref)` nor adds the previously blocked anchors to the dependants map. Same failure mode the diff repairs in `moveRangeTo`: a cell that was blocking a spill is erased by merging over it and the anchor stays `#REF!` until something else touches it. The diff's own comment calls this 'the same contract removeData follows', so this site is now inconsistent with the documented contract.

samples.summary: `autofill` overwrite/clear path does not consume spill blockers either
samples.evidence: packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:2696 and :2706 delete destination cells during autofill and :2679/:2708 overwrite them, then recalc from `changedSrefs` only (line 2714-2719). If an autofilled-over cell was registered in `spillBlockers`, the entry is never consumed and the blocked anchor is never re-queued, so a spill that autofill just unblocked stays `#REF!`. This is the same contract the diff now enforces in `moveRangeTo`; autofill was left on the old behaviour.

samples.summary: `Worksheet.cleanup()` drops the sheet but never unregisters the new `setOnRefusal` callback
samples.evidence: `initialize` now installs `this.sheet.setOnRefusal((refusal) => this.onNoticeCallback?.(...))` (packages/sheets/src/view/worksheet.ts:417). `cleanup()` at packages/sheets/src/view/worksheet.ts:588 only does `this.sheet = undefined`; the Sheet keeps a closure over the torn-down Worksheet. `setOnRefusal` is a single slot, so if a Sheet is ever reused across two Worksheet instances (or a host registers directly on the model, as the new tests do) the last registration silently wins and the earlier listener is lost. Fix belongs on the new code: clear the hook in `cleanup()` and/or make `setOnRefusal` return an unsubscribe like `onSelectionChange` does.
searchedFor: grep worksheet.initialize / new Sheet( call sites

samples.summary: Other `Spreadsheet` hosts never register `onNotice`, so refusals stay silent there
samples.evidence: packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/datasource-view.tsx:62 and packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/lakehouse-view.tsx:111 both call `initialize(...)` and never call the new `s.onNotice(...)` that sheet-view.tsx:1020 adds. Both pass `readOnly: true`, which likely makes drag-move/autofill unreachable, so impact is low — but if any refusable gesture is reachable in those grids the user gets the exact silent no-op this change exists to remove.

samples.summary: Unblocked anchors injected into the recalculation may be stale srefs after a move/shift
samples.evidence: `spillBlockers` is keyed and valued by absolute srefs and is never remapped by `moveRangeTo` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:2295+) or `shiftCells` (line 1259+), which relocate cells. The diff now takes whatever anchor sref `consumeSpillBlocker` returns and force-inserts it into `expanded` and `dependantsMap` (lines 2477-2480), so a stale anchor sref (its formula cell having since moved or been shifted away) is fed to `calculate`. Would need a test moving a spill anchor and then dragging its blocker to confirm whether `calculate` tolerates a sref with no cell.

finding.summary: Cut-paste source clearing still bypasses the `consumeSpillBlocker()` contract the diff establishes for drag-move
finding.evidence: The diff adds `consumeSpillBlocker()` to both `moveRangeTo` clearing loops (sheet.ts:2392, 2461) and re-queues the unblocked anchors so a blocked spill recovers. The sibling path `paste()` clears the cut source range at packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:2227-2236 (`await this.store.delete({ r, c })`) with no `consumeSpillBlocker()` call and no unblocked-anchor injection into the `dependantsMap` built at line 2219 — and that recalculation happens BEFORE the source clearing anyway. So cutting a cell that was blocking a spill leaves the anchor stuck at `#REF!` exactly like the bug the diff fixes for drag-move. The registration also stays in `spillBlockers`, keyed to a now-empty cell.

verdict.reason: The `spillBlockers` map is private to sheet.ts (line 313), so all consumption sites are enumerable: consumeSpillBlocker is called only at sheet.ts:1113 (setData), 1182 (removeData), 2392 and 2461 (moveRangeTo). paste()'s cut-source clearing loop at sheet.ts:2226-2239 deletes source cells (line 2233) with no consumeSpillBlocker call and no unblocked-anchor set; its recalculation at 2217-2221 runs before the clearing and covers only pasted srefs and their dependants. No indirect recovery exists: redirectFormulasForCut (2517-2539) only recalculates cells whose formula text changed, calculate() in calculator.ts:41-166 never retries spillBlocked anchors (registrations only change at calculator.ts:117/130), and the store layers (memory.ts:110, readonly.ts:93, store.ts:47) are spill-agnostic. Tests cover the drag-move recovery (calculation.test.ts:202) but not cut-paste. So cutting a cell that blocks a spill leaves the anchor stuck at #REF! and a stale blocker entry keyed to an emptied cell — a reachable bypass of the contract the diff establishes, in-lane and major.

verdict.reason: Verified in the repo: `mergeSelection` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:4384-4396) deletes/blanks every non-anchor cell in the merge range and then recalculates only from `expandChangedSrefsWithMergeAliases(changedSrefs)` (4402-4404), with no `consumeSpillBlocker` and no unblocked-anchor injection into the dependants map. `consumeSpillBlocker` (993) has only four call sites — setData 1113, removeData 1182, moveRangeTo 2392 and 2461 — each of which also adds the anchor to the changed set and the dependants map (1114-1117, 1194-1197, 2477-2480). No indirect recovery exists: `expandChangedSrefsWithMergeAliases` (883-898) never consults `spillBlockers`; `spillBlockers` is referenced only inside sheet.ts (313, 976, 984-985, 994-995); and `calculate` (calculator.ts:41-145) only processes the srefs passed to it, re-registering blockers at 115-127 rather than globally re-attempting blocked spills. `canMergeSelection` (4335-4352) has no spill guard, so the path is reachable (spill anchored at A1 spanning A1:E1 blocked by user data in D1; merging C1:D1 erases D1 while A1 stays #REF! and the stale D1->A1 registration survives). The repo's own note (docs/tasks/active/20260822-sheets-merge-refusal-notice-todo.md:11-15) names only setData/removeData as honouring the contract. In-lane for blast radius: another mutation entry point reaches the same cell-clearing operation without honouring the invariant the diff enforces in moveRangeTo.

finding.summary: `autofill` overwrite/clear path does not consume spill blockers either
finding.evidence: packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:2696 and :2706 delete destination cells during autofill and :2679/:2708 overwrite them, then recalc from `changedSrefs` only (line 2714-2719). If an autofilled-over cell was registered in `spillBlockers`, the entry is never consumed and the blocked anchor is never re-queued, so a spill that autofill just unblocked stays `#REF!`. This is the same contract the diff now enforces in `moveRangeTo`; autofill was left on the old behaviour.

verdict.reason: Verified independently: repo-wide grep finds only four `consumeSpillBlocker()` call sites (sheet.ts:1113 setData, :1182 removeData, :2392 and :2461 moveRangeTo). The `autofill` body (sheet.ts:2558-2736) contains none — its destination clears (`store.delete` at :2696 and :2706) and overwrites (:2679, :2708) go straight to the store, and the recalculation at :2714-2719 seeds `calculate` from `changedSrefs` only, with no `unblockedAnchors` set like moveRangeTo :2472-2482 and removeData :1194-1197 have. `calculate` (calculator.ts:41-166) never rescans `spillBlockers` to re-queue blocked anchors; it only registers (:117) and clears (:130) for anchors already in `refs`, so recovery is impossible unless the caller adds the anchor explicitly. The path is reachable: autofill is invoked from view/worksheet.ts:4195, and the only in-loop skip is for ghost cells (`existingDest?.spillAnchor`, sheet.ts:2642) — a spill blocker is ordinary user data and is not skipped. Result: an autofill that clears a registered blocker leaves the stale entry in `spillBlockers` and the blocked anchor stuck at `#REF!` — a violated invariant that the calculator and the other model clearing paths depend on, i.e. squarely in the blast-radius lane at major. No counterexample exists elsewhere in the repo (only one autofill implementation).
